text:
jun: Heads-up — AeroLumen (acct ALM-778) opened a payment hold. Invoice INV-2026-207 (due 2026-03-02) outstanding: $132,450. They say a sudden test cluster ramp created a usage spike (~$20k) and want that portion credited. Also asking to pay $60k now via international wire, cover remaining later.
maria: Thanks. Any history of disputes like this?
clare: Sales says AeroLumen is strategic but notorious for slow AP. They requested net-90 last year and delivered. Procurement asked for a VAT invoice too.
billing-bot: Last payment: 2026-01-14. Recent billing spike on 2026-02-28 flagged by anomaly detector: +153% usage vs baseline. Auto-flag created.
devin: Finance POV: we can accept a partial wire now, but need payment trace and payer name. Wire fees should be charged back. If they want extended terms, need CFO approval.
lina: Payments: ok to accept SWIFT wire. We require beneficiary details and IBAN/SWIFT. Recommend holding new seat provisioning until cleared.
oscar: CFO here — net-90 can be approved for strategic accounts but only with collateral (signed payment plan + sent wire of >=40%). Also want remediation credits for proven platform bug only.
jun: They sent an email with usage logs claiming the $20k is test env mis-billing and attached some Grafana screenshots. We need our telemetry match.
maria: Ops/metrics team to recon telemetry vs their screenshots. If mismatch, deny credit. If match, offer one-time operational credit up to disputed amount.
clare: Sales suggests: accept $60k wire now, place a conditional hold on new seats, provide provisional credit of $10k pending deeper recon, and allow net-60 for remaining balance if they sign plan.
devin: I'd prefer a three-line plan: 40% now ($52,980), 30% in 30 days ($39,735), 30% in 60 days ($39,735). Wire covers the first tranche. If we do less upfront, require a signed statement and procurement PO. Also insist they cover wire fees.
lina: Noted — we will provide bank instructions and SWIFT reference template. We need payer company legal name exactly as on bank record.
oscar: Legal fine with conditional credit but require a post-mortem clause: if disputed usage proves our error, issue credit; if not, customer remains liable. Also add 'no rights waived' language.
jun: I'll coordinate Ops recon and ask them for bank remittance details + PO. I'll also attach a copy of our telemetry once done.
maria: Can we offer a small one-off goodwill credit (max $5k) without escalating to CFO? If so, might ease negotiations.
oscar: OK to approve up to $5k goodwill credit. Anything above requires finance exec sign-off.
clare: Sales will offer the following to customer in next outreach: bank instructions for immediate wire (covering fees), request for PO or signer, conditional provisional $10k credit pending telemetry, and a 60-day payment plan for remaining balance. Mention seat provisioning hold until first tranche clears.
devin: Approve plan contingent on receiving wire remittance and signed payment plan.
jun: Draft message (will paste after sending): "Hi AeroLumen — we received your dispute. To avoid service disruption while we investigate, please wire $60,000 to the account below (cover SWIFT fees) and reply with remittance. We will provisionally apply a $10,000 credit pending telemetry reconciliation (final determination within 10 business days). Remaining balance may be split over 60 days upon receipt of signed payment plan and PO. New seat provisioning will be paused until first tranche clears. If no remittance or signed plan within 7 business days, collections escalation will proceed." OK to send?
maria: Approve to send. Add line asking for VAT billing address for invoice adjustment.
lina: I'll DM bank details once they confirm wiring party.
clare: On it — Sales will keep pressure but avoid public threats. :handshake:
jun: Sent to ap@aerolumen.io at 2026-03-03 09:22 UTC 1: Subject: Payment & usage reconciliation for INV-2026-207"
